title: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs
subtitle: Eggs cooked in the air fryer for a set white and fully cooked yolk.
excerpt: Eggs placed directly in the air fryer basket and cooked at 150°C for 15 minutes, then transferred to cold water for easy peeling. Consistently set whites and fully cooked yolks with no boiling water required. Makes six eggs.
sourceNotes: Hard-boiled eggs in the air fryer were popularised through American cooking blogs around 2015 and work because the dry heat of the air fryer reaches the egg at the same temperature and consistency as boiling water. The result is easier to peel than water-boiled eggs.

recipe.batchNotes: Cook up to the capacity of your air fryer basket in one batch.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Unpeeled cooked eggs keep in the fridge for up to 5 days.

content.text: Eggs in the air fryer cook by dry heat rather than water, which changes the texture slightly ,  the white is a little more tender and the shell peels away cleanly. Cook at 150°C, not higher: above 160°C the white nearest the shell goes rubbery before the yolk is set. Transfer immediately to cold water when done so the residual heat doesn't carry the yolk to overcooking.

Preheat the air fryer to 150°C. Place the {{eggs}} directly in the basket, not touching each other. Cook for 15 minutes. Using tongs, transfer the eggs immediately to a bowl of cold water and leave for 10 minutes. Peel under a thin trickle of cold water: the shell should come away cleanly in large pieces.

items.cause: Overcooked or not transferred to cold water fast enough.
items.fix: Move eggs to cold water immediately when the timer goes. The grey ring forms when sulphur from the white meets iron in the yolk at high temperature.

items.symptom: Shell sticking and white tearing when peeled
items.cause: Eggs too fresh, or not chilled adequately.
items.fix: Very fresh eggs are notoriously hard to peel. If possible, use eggs 7-10 days old. Always peel under cold running water.

items.cause: Eggs taken straight from the fridge rather than at room temperature.
items.fix: Cold eggs need 2-3 extra minutes. Bring to room temperature for 20 minutes before cooking.

content.text: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs are useful for packed lunches, egg mayonnaise, Scotch eggs, salads, or devilled eggs. They keep unpeeled in the fridge for up to 5 days. The same method at 150°C for 10 minutes gives a set white with a slightly jammy, semi-soft yolk.
